clue.text: Final free property to house them

indicators.note: to house means to hold inside, so one piece is placed within the other
free here means released from its order, so the letters of property are loosened and rearranged

parts.note: 'em is the informal clipped form of them

explanation.surface: A last, unencumbered piece of real estate meant to give someone a home.
explanation.definitionFit: A peremptory order is final, allowing no debate or appeal.

parts.note: to paw is to handle someone clumsily, laying hands on them

explanation.surface: Grabbing hold of a freshly bought implement.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively, a person used by others for their own ends is a pawn or tool.

definitions.meaning: read as '...', managing the pop singer Cher
a cattle farmer or ranch hand, a cowboy

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a pop star's former manager was a cowboy, a shady operator.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition splits the word as RAN CHER: Cher is the American pop singer.
explanation.definitionFit: A cattle farmer working a ranch in the American West is the archetypal cowboy.

clue.text: Game which only the one behind can win

definitions.text: Game which only the one behind can win

parts.words: Game which only the one behind can win
parts.note: the 'behind' is the bottom that must land on the last remaining seat when the music stops

explanation.surface: A puzzling contest in which only the trailing player can triumph.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the one behind' seems to mean the player lagging last, but it is a backside: the winner gets the final seat.
explanation.definitionFit: A party game where players circle seats and scramble to sit when the music stops, one seat removed each round.

indicators.note: sound of means the word is said aloud and heard as a different spelling

parts.note: the throne is a jokey slang term for the lavatory

explanation.surface: Noise from a lavatory inside a garden shed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed' looks like a garden building but is a verb form: thrown off, as a horse sheds its rider.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cast off, like a rider tossed by a horse, has been thrown or shed.

clue.text: Pure lust can make you get together

indicators.note: the letters of the words can be remade into something new, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Raw desire can bring people together.
explanation.definitionFit: To get together a meal or team quickly from what is to hand is to rustle it up.

indicators.note: nets means catches, so the answer is caught within the words

explanation.surface: Frames that support the netting hold nets in place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nets' looks like the definition, but it signals the letters caught across 'frames hold'.
explanation.definitionFit: A fabric of crossed threads with open spaces is a mesh, the material of a net.

clue.text: Tennis player available for football team

parts.note: Chris Evert, the American tennis champion
on means available, as in 'on offer'

explanation.surface: A tennis star is free to turn out for a football side.
explanation.definitionFit: A Premier League club from Liverpool, England, nicknamed the Toffees.

clue.text: The king welcomes PM, welcomes banter

parts.note: his read as hi's, the plural of hi: greetings or welcomes

indicators.note: welcomes means takes in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Theresa May, former British Prime Minister
jest is joking talk, banter

explanation.surface: The monarch receives the Prime Minister and enjoys some joking with them.
explanation.walkthrough: The two 'welcomes' do different jobs: the first is a noun plural (greetings, hi's), the second the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The formal style for a reigning male monarch, used when referring to the king.

clue.text: Collect a Nintendo console or a tie

parts.note: to collect a prize is to win it
the DS is a Nintendo handheld games console

explanation.surface: A prize choice: take a games console or a necktie.
explanation.definitionFit: A Windsor is a wide, symmetrical knot for a necktie, so by extension a tie style.

parts.note: films that carry on a story from earlier ones; the Carry On comedies were a long British film series

explanation.surface: A reference to the long-running British Carry On comedy film series.
explanation.walkthrough: The Carry On films were a long series of British comedies; read literally, films that carry on a story are follow-ups.
explanation.definitionFit: Follow-up films that continue an earlier story literally carry it on.

definitions.meaning: a rider is an added clause limiting a statement, a proviso
an accomplishment or competence, such as a certified ability

explanation.surface: Talking about a horseman's ability.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rider' suggests horses but means a proviso added to a document.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a limiting condition attached to a statement and an attained competence.

clue.text: Lizard has to leave area around rock face

indicators.note: around here means the area letter comes round the back, placed after the climbing surface

parts.note: to chuck a job is to leave it
a sheer rock face is a wall, as in climbing

explanation.surface: A lizard has to quit the area near a cliff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' is used loosely here to put A after WALL.
explanation.definitionFit: A large lizard of the deserts of the southwestern USA and Mexico.

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter is cut off

parts.note: a teat is what milk is drawn from

explanation.surface: Asking whether you can drink milk from something, more or less.
explanation.definitionFit: A cuppa is a common hot drink, often taken with milk.

definitions.meaning: to see the worth of something, to recognise or value it
to rise in worth, as property does

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to recognise the worth of something and to gain worth over time.

parts.note: a PA, a personal assistant, does secretarial work
a role is a job or function, one's work

explanation.surface: An office job offered as part of a prisoner release programme.
explanation.definitionFit: Early conditional release of a prisoner under supervision is this scheme.

definitions.meaning: a formal interview with someone important
the people in a theatre, as in 'a full house'

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a formal meeting with a dignitary and the spectators in a theatre.

parts.note: everybody means all; the 's of the phrase is supplied by the wave's first letter
a swell is a long rolling wave

explanation.surface: Everyone waving to signal contentment.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a stock declaration that things are fine and everyone is content.

clue.text: Degenerate knight in here, all agitated

indicators.note: agitated means stirred up, so the letters are shaken into a new order

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for knight
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dissolute knight is here, and everybody is upset.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a dissolute rake, a debauched and degenerate man.

clue.text: Huge profit hardly essential to former bank governor

indicators.note: essential to means at the heart of, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: Mervyn King, former Governor of the Bank of England
ill means hardly, as in 'can ill afford'

explanation.surface: A huge profit scarcely matters to an ex-head of a central bank.
explanation.walkthrough: Mervyn King governed the Bank of England from 2003 to 2013.
explanation.definitionFit: Making a killing is the idiom for a sudden large profit.

parts.note: Whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet
id est, Latin for 'that is', abbreviated i.e.

explanation.surface: A drink offered as the most generous gesture.
explanation.definitionFit: The broadest or most ample measure, as in the widest pour.

clue.text: Say too much about one's being boastful

parts.note: eg, for example, means say

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: OTT is short for over the top, too much
one's read as I's, I is

explanation.surface: Talking excessively about oneself is bragging.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' arguably does double duty, giving the inserted letters and also hinting at the definition's 'one being boastful'.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-obsessed person forever boasting about themselves; the definition describes such a person.

parts.note: Di, Diana, Princess of Wales

indicators.note: bust means broken, so these letters are smashed into a new order

explanation.surface: A royal has a sculpted bust made of herself.
explanation.definitionFit: A jewelled headband worn as a sign of royalty is a kind of crown.

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word

explanation.surface: Walking past a school at regular intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: A mountain pass, a low point in a ridge, is called by this word.

clue.text: One starting out, initially poor leader

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: poor means in a bad state, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of the word out

explanation.surface: Someone beginning their career who is at first an inadequate leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes O from 'out'; 'poor' rearranges I, STARTING and O. 'One starting' looks like the definition, but it is the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The person who sets something going, a ringleader, leads it.

parts.note: wee means very small, like a midget

explanation.surface: A girl's name, Mary Jane, given to a small person's daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: Mary Jane is slang for marijuana.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are slang names for cannabis.

parts.note: tissue is the substance of the body, its matter

explanation.surface: A subject currently under discussion.
explanation.definitionFit: A point at issue is the one under dispute or debate.

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to judge is to decide
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A judge taking on someone's divine slaughter case.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 is KILLING (19-down), so the definition reads 'killing of god'.
explanation.definitionFit: The slaying of a deity, from Latin deus (god) plus -cide (killing).

parts.note: er, like um, is a hesitation noise
go means leave

explanation.surface: A hesitant speaker trails off and departs.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for therefore, used to introduce a conclusion.

clue.text: Was killer ecstatic about accomplice's words?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: elated means ecstatic
'I'm in' is what an accomplice says on joining a plot

explanation.surface: Was a murderer thrilled about what an accomplice said?
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'I'm in' is just one thing an accomplice might say.
explanation.definitionFit: To eliminate someone is a euphemism for to kill; the definition is loosely phrased as having been a killer.
